TFRulesSettings +Pehle 70%Baad ke 30% (unseen)

    Har line mein wo setting dikhayi gayi hai jo sirf pehle 70% data par sabse achhi thi, aur phir usi ka result unseen 30% data par. "Settings +" = kitni settings pehle 70% par positive thi (100+ trades ke saath).

    Inter Equity rules (jo software check karta hai)

    Saari 155 videos (course, case studies, 39 webinars, 15 live calls) se banaya gaya. Har setup par 20 rules check hote hain. A = sab theek (poora risk), B = core theek, kuch warning (aadha risk), X = koi hard rule toota (IE ye trade nahi leta, alert nahi aata).

    1. Setup (Da Vinci). Purani liquidity sweep ho kar liquidity block bane, displacement ho. Neeche buildup (BOS + lower high), lows par engineered liquidity, phir buildup le kar price LB mein aaye: wahan entry. Stop LB ke paar, pehle target tak kam az kam 1:3. With structure trade nahi. Liquidity "from the left" sweep honi chahiye, aur LB ke paar liquidity bachi ho to warning.
    2. Direction. HTF (4h) narrative ke saath. Buy se pehle aaj ka koi low (PDL, Asia, London) liya gaya ho, sell se pehle high. All-time-high / HTF extreme par warning.
    3. Time. Sirf New York: entry 8-11 NY (indices 9:30 stock open ke baad). NFP/FOMC (aur PC app mein live red news) se pehle entry nahi. Bank holiday par trade nahi. 9-10 trap hour.
    4. Day type. Kal bara move hua to aaj range day (skip). Asia aur London dono bara move kar chuke hon to NY aksar dead. FOMC/NFP se pehle wala din: warning.
    5. Management. Pehle target par 80% close aur stop break-even; agla structural low/high liya to break-even; baqi agli liquidity tak, 4 pm NY (Friday 12) tak band. Din mein 2 trades / 2 losses max.

    Marco ka apna strike rate (22 Mar 2025 webinar): "35 se 50%". Profit RR (1:3+) aur partials se aata hai, 70-80% win rate se nahi. Yeh software rules ko mechanically check karta hai; HTF "feel" aur discretion poori tarah code mein nahi aa sakti.

    Educational tool. Financial advice nahi. Backtest future profit ki guarantee nahi deta. Data: Yahoo Finance (gold/indices futures ~10 min delayed, forex near real-time), jo broker prices se thoda alag ho sakta hai.
